contents: What S7040E is and where it fits

slides.title: S7040E at a Glance
slides.lead: A dedicated eyelet insertion machine: 4 insertion heads and 4 vibration bowls insert bulk eyelets and flare them from below, with vision correction and insertion check on every point.
apps: Eyelets, hollow rivets and rivet pins, Ø1.3–4.0 mm, up to 4 sizes per board
Appliance and power boards, single-sided boards needing reinforced holes
4 vibration bowls for bulk eyelets (reel feeder optional)
slides.caption: Board with inserted eyelets
slides.notes: Eyelet range Ø1.3–4.0 mm: AGENTS 4.3 (S7040E, S-7000E Upgrade). Photo: Jason upload 'Eyelet Insertion PCB'.

slides.title: Why Manual Eyelet Insertion Holds Lines Back
slides.lead: Eyelets are tiny and must be flared evenly. Hand insertion and hand riveting cap output and quality.
items: Insert by hand, then rivet at a press
Cracked or loose eyelets fail at soldering
Found only after soldering, then reworked
Mixing diameters by hand causes errors
No record of what was inserted and when
slides.notes: Qualitative customer pains. No figures claimed.

slides.title: Key Figures
slides.lead: S7040E = S7020T platform with 4 insertion heads and 4 feeders, dedicated to eyelets.
items: Up to 4 eyelet sizes, no changeover
slides.footer: 7,200 parts/h = 3,600 s ÷ 0.5 s, insertion only; PCB in/out and Mark reading are added per board.
slides.notes: AGENTS.md v2 sec 4.2 (Jason, 2026-11-07); S7020 Series 202303; S7020T manual. 0.5 s/part unified figure (Jason).

slides.title: FAB 1 · Four Heads, Four Bowls
rows: One eyelet at a time to the head
slides.notes: Bowl flow (sort -> linear track -> slider -> air to gripper): AGENTS feeder section (S-7000E). Bottom die splits and flares ('pressing to blossom'): AGENTS 3.3.

slides.title: FAB 2 · Accuracy, Checks and Data
rows: Base supports and checks each eyelet
slides.notes: Correction 0.015 mm, insertion detection: S7020T manual. Programming/communication: AGENTS 4.2.

Bottom die splits and flares the eyelet

slides.footer: All models: 1700 × 1300 × 1600 mm, 1500 kg, 1.6 KVA, PCB 380 × 280 mm (customizable).

slides.title: Capacity Example
slides.lead: 0.5 s per eyelet, plus 4 s PCB in/out and 1 s Mark reading per board.
slides.footer: Boards/h = 3,600 ÷ s/board, rounded down, before efficiency factor. Confirm with your board in a sample run.
slides.notes: 28 eyelets = 20 + 8 example board in Jason's S-7000 PDF (p3/p4). PCB in/out 4 s + Mark 1 s: same assumption as S7040P/S7020T decks.

slides.title: Summary & Next Step
slides.lead: S7040E inserts and flares up to four eyelet sizes per pass at 0.5 s per part, with vision correction and insertion check.
